summary: A guitar chord box: it sends the notes of a chord, shaped as a strum with a delay per string, to target machines on a MIDI channel. It makes no sound itself.
use_for: Strum guitar-style chords from single notes, with per-string delays and humanising.
quirks: It is a control machine with a window that picks the chord: the chord grid and the target machines are chosen there, not through parameters, so nothing plays until a person picks them.
String delays are in milliseconds up to 2,000 and each string has its own timer; MIDI channel is 0-based (raw 0 is channel 1); Transpose is raw 12 for none.
Unverified: which machines receive the notes by default, and the chord shapes it offers.
Closed source (a prebuilt DLL): names come from its own texts, its DLL's type names and the profile, not from code.
evidence: its parameter descriptions and value texts (machine_describe, as profiled)
RunTime/Gear/Generators/GuitarChordBox.NET.dll — type and member names read from the DLL (per-string timers, chord grid and sending of notes to target machines)
profile (tools/machine-profiler.py, windows 2026-11-14) - a control machine, no sound

parameters.name: SendNotes
parameters.how: Switches the sending of notes off or on: No (the default) or Yes.
parameters.sound: At Yes the chord you pick in its window plays on the target machines; at No it stays silent.

parameters.name: MIDIChannel
parameters.how: Chooses the MIDI channel the notes are sent on, 0 to 15 (0 by default, which is channel 1).
parameters.sound: Use it to address one part of a multi-timbral device.

parameters.name: SendVelocity
parameters.how: Sets the velocity of the sent notes, 0 to 127 (60 by default).
parameters.sound: Higher values strike the notes harder.

parameters.name: VolRandom
parameters.how: Sets how much random variation is added to the note volumes, 0 to 127 (0 by default).
parameters.sound: More variation makes the chord sound played by hand rather than by machine.

parameters.name: DelayRandom
parameters.how: Sets how much random delay is added to the notes, 0 to 2,000 ms (0 by default).
parameters.sound: More delay loosens the timing of the chord into a rough strum.

parameters.name: StringEDelay
parameters.how: Sets the delay of the low E string's note, 0 to 2 s (0 by default).
parameters.sound: Staggering the strings produces a strum.

parameters.name: StringADelay
parameters.how: Sets the delay of the A string's note, 0 to 2 s (0 by default).
parameters.sound: Staggering the strings produces a strum.

parameters.name: StringDDelay
parameters.how: Sets the delay of the D string's note, 0 to 2 s (0 by default).
parameters.sound: Staggering the strings produces a strum.

parameters.name: StringGDelay
parameters.how: Sets the delay of the G string's note, 0 to 2 s (0 by default).
parameters.sound: Staggering the strings produces a strum.

parameters.name: StringBDelay
parameters.how: Sets the delay of the B string's note, 0 to 2 s (0 by default).
parameters.sound: Staggering the strings produces a strum.

parameters.name: StringE2Delay
parameters.how: Sets the delay of the high E string's note, 0 to 2 s (0 by default).
parameters.sound: Staggering the strings produces a strum.

parameters.name: Transpose
parameters.description: Transposes the notes by -12 to +12 semitones (raw 12 is none, the default).
parameters.how: Transposes the notes by -12 to +12 semitones (raw 12 is none, the default).
parameters.sound: Moves the whole chord up or down in pitch.
